description: This file defines an object 'WakeWords' containing constants and utility functions for handling wake words, such as parsing comma-separated strings, detecting changes, and sanitizing the list of wake words.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparated
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseIfChanged
methods.description: Parses input string into list and compares with current; returns new list if changed, otherwise null.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Cleans up the list of words by trimming, filtering, and limiting length and count; defaults if resulting list is empty.
